Flow.description: F-08 core (Phase 4, D-12). One subflow = one place for the monotone advance rule. Input: CareProgram Id. Reads the study, its sites, the EM-keyed onboarding Tasks, the active template rows and the sites' regulatory checklist. (1) Checklist -> Regulatory Packet Complete + Missing Regulatory Documents (only when required checklist items exist). (2) Pass 1: a task completed BY A PERSON stamps its evidence field on the study with the first satisfying value (picklists, checkboxes, dates; never Internal Greenlight — approval only). (3) Pass 2: an open task whose evidence is met is auto-completed (EM Auto Completed = true; re-opened Exception tasks are left alone); required items are counted; the earliest open required task becomes the Next Action. (4) Progress % = completed required / required; Onboarding Status = max(current, highest contiguous satisfied step) — never auto-regresses; Current Step names the first unsatisfied step. (5) Site Activated -> Status = Recruiting and SiteActivatedDate on every site. Writes only when a value actually changed, so the after-save triggers that call it always converge. Migration Mode is honoured by the callers.
